design_detail: Retraction note, not a study (Psychopharmacology vol. 241, p. 2403, November 2024 issue; published online 10 August 2024; open access, CC BY), retracting Feduccia, Jerome, Mithoefer and Holland, 'Discontinuation of medications classified as reuptake inhibitors affects treatment response of MDMA-assisted psychotherapy' (Psychopharmacology 238:581-588; published online 21 November 2020). Two short paragraphs, no data. Read on the publisher's page (link.springer.com, reached through doi.org) in the app's browser; the Crossref records of the notice and of the retracted article were read in the same tab. Card design 'narrative-review' is the schema's closest category for an editorial notice. Reference id assigned by this reader (first author in Crossref plus year); the reference record is to be built by the editor from the Crossref line added to the cache.
can_establish: That Psychopharmacology retracted this article on 10 August 2024, the grounds the editors gave, and which authors agreed or disagreed with the retraction.
cannot_establish: What the protocol violations at the MP4 site were, how much of the article's data came from that site, or whether its findings would change without those data: the notice gives none of these.

analysis.selective_reporting: The notice does not describe the violations, does not say which authors confirmed knowing of them, and does not say how much of the analysed data came from the MP4 site.

interpretation_gap.results_show: An editorial decision and its stated grounds: protocol violations amounting to unethical conduct at the MP4 study site, known to the authors at submission and neither disclosed to the journal nor removed from the analysis; and a potential competing interest not fully declared.
interpretation_gap.claimed: The notice claims nothing beyond its grounds and the authors' positions.

timeline.event: The article is published online (21 November 2020; print issue February 2021 per Crossref).
This retraction note (10 August 2024), issued the same day as the notes for two other phase 2 analyses from the same programme (Jerome et al., 2024; Mithoefer et al., 2024).
The BMJ reports the three retractions (Mahase, 2024).

replication.where_it_stands: Retracted. Under METHODS §4.3 the retracted article cannot support any claim; this notice may be cited for the fact of the retraction and its stated grounds.

funding.funder: Not applicable (notice). The notice states, from the article's funding declaration, that MAPS fully funded the trial and provided the MDMA, and that MAPS PBC organised the trial.
funding.declared_conflicts: Per the notice, the authors did not fully declare a potential competing interest: two of the authors are affiliated with MAPS Public Benefit Corporation (MAPS PBC), a subsidiary wholly owned by MAPS.
funding.affiliations_note: Affiliations listed with the notice: Allison A. Feduccia, Psychedelic.Support, Project New Day, Santa Cruz, CA; Lisa Jerome and Michael C. Mithoefer, MAPS Public Benefit Corporation, Santa Cruz, CA (Mithoefer also Medical University of South Carolina); Julie Holland, private practice, New York.

what_would_settle_it: For the article's question: the analysis re-run without the MP4 site's data and published with the reasons for the retraction; for the programme as a whole, the regulator's assessment of the site's data.

domains.note: Not a review: the notice reports the editors' own decision on one article, so nothing is selected.
The notice does not say how the violations were established or how much of the article's data came from the site.

domains.domain: Reliance on the authors' own studies

domains.note: States the decision and its grounds without speculation.

domains.domain: Balance of views on the retraction (the authors' positions)
domains.note: Records which authors agree and which disagree.

risk_of_bias.reasoning: No validated instrument applies to retraction notices; the editors' narrative-review checklist is used as the closest available, its domains read as questions about the notice as a source. The notice is the primary record of the retraction and its stated grounds and may be cited for both; it gives no account of the violations and no reanalysis.

key_findings.finding: Retraction note published 10 August 2024 (Psychopharmacology 241, p. 2403; issue date November 2024) for the original article published on 21 November 2020, cited in the notice as Psychopharmacology (2020) 238:581-588, doi 10.1007/s00213-020-05710-w.
key_findings.locator: Article header; 'The Original Article was published on' line

key_findings.finding: The editors retracted the article after they were informed of protocol violations amounting to unethical conduct at the MP4 study site by researchers associated with the project. The authors then confirmed that they had known of these violations when they submitted the article but did not disclose this to the journal or remove that site's data from their analysis.

The authors also did not fully declare a potential competing interest: two of the authors are affiliated with MAPS PBC, a subsidiary wholly owned by MAPS. As the article's funding declaration stated, MAPS fully funded the trial and provided the MDMA, and MAPS PBC organised the trial.
Allison A. Feduccia agrees with the retraction but disagrees with the wording of the notice; Lisa Jerome, Michael C. Mithoefer and Julie Holland disagree with the retraction.

The notice's Crossref record (vol. 241, issue 11, page 2403; online 10 August 2024, print November 2024; authors Feduccia, Jerome, Mithoefer, Holland) carries an update-to link of type 'retraction', from both Retraction Watch and the publisher, dated 10 August 2024, pointing to 10.1007/s00213-020-05710-w; that article's record carries the matching updated-by link, its title now begins 'RETRACTED ARTICLE', and its print issue is given as February 2021 (vol. 238, issue 2, pp. 581-588).

reporting_issues.issue: The notice cites the original as Psychopharmacology (2020) 238:581-588; Crossref gives the print issue of volume 238 as February 2021, the 2020 date being the online date.
reporting_issues.consequence: Minor; the retracted article cannot support claims in any case (METHODS §4.3).

reporting_issues.issue: The notice says 'the authors' confirmed knowing of the violations at submission, without saying which authors; three of the four authors disagree with the retraction.
reporting_issues.consequence: Cite the notice's wording; do not attribute the confirmation to any named author.

verification.source_read: Publisher full text (HTML), https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00213-024-06671-0 (reached through doi.org), read in full in the app's browser, with the Crossref records of the notice and of the retracted article (api.crossref.org/works/<DOI>) read in the same tab.
